label: General guidance, follow the call-taker.
note: Pre-written, static guidance. It does not diagnose and does not replace the call-taker or a trained responder. Not clinically validated in this prototype.

categories.title: Not breathing / no response: chest compressions

steps.text: Lay the person on their back on a firm surface.
steps.say: Lay the person on their back on a firm surface.

steps.text: Kneel beside them. Put the heel of one hand on the centre of the chest, the other hand on top.
steps.say: Put the heel of one hand on the centre of the chest, and the other hand on top.

steps.text: Push hard and fast, about 5 cm deep, 100 to 120 times a minute. Follow the beat.
steps.say: Push hard and fast in the centre of the chest. Follow the beat.

steps.text: Let the chest rise fully between pushes.
steps.say: Let the chest come back up between pushes.

steps.text: If you are trained and willing: after 30 pushes give 2 breaths. If not, keep pushing without stopping.
steps.say: If you are trained, give two breaths after thirty pushes. If not, keep pushing.

steps.text: If an AED arrives, switch it on and follow its voice prompts.
steps.say: If a defibrillator arrives, switch it on and follow its voice prompts.

steps.text: Do not stop until the ambulance crew takes over or the person starts to move.
steps.say: Do not stop until the crew takes over.

steps.text: Press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth or clothing. Use your hand if you have nothing else.
steps.say: Press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth.

steps.text: Keep pressing. Do not lift to check.
steps.say: Keep pressing. Do not lift the cloth to check.

steps.text: If blood soaks through, add more cloth on top and press harder.
steps.say: If blood soaks through, add more cloth on top and press harder.

steps.text: Lay the person down. Keep them warm.
steps.say: Lay the person down and keep them warm.

steps.text: Do not remove objects stuck in the wound.
steps.say: Do not remove anything stuck in the wound.

categories.title: Choking: cannot speak, cough or breathe

steps.text: If they can cough, tell them to keep coughing.
steps.say: If they can cough, tell them to keep coughing.

steps.text: If they cannot: lean them forward and give up to 5 firm blows between the shoulder blades.
steps.say: Lean them forward and give up to five firm blows between the shoulder blades.

steps.text: Still blocked: stand behind them, fist above the navel, pull sharply inwards and upwards, up to 5 times.
steps.say: Stand behind them, fist above the navel, and pull sharply inwards and upwards, up to five times.

steps.text: Alternate 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts until the object comes out.
steps.say: Alternate five back blows and five thrusts.

steps.text: If they become unresponsive, tell the call-taker. Start chest compressions as guided.
steps.say: If they become unresponsive, tell the call-taker.
